newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF pays 67.6 bln yen to private sector in Nov.
newsitem.headline: MOF pays 67.6 bln yen to private sector in Nov.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance's (MOF) special foreign exchange account paid out 67.6 billion yen to the private sector in November, MOF data showed on Monday.
The account manages Japan's external reserves, the world's largest, which stood at $216.2 billion at the end of October.

The payments are yen payments from the account to the private sector, such as dollar-buying intervention for yen, but bankers said there was no trace of such intervention this month. The MOF does not comment on details of the payments.
The private sector is comprised of commercial banks, foreign central banks, municipal governments, public funds and quasi-governmental organisations.
